culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Kosuke Hishinuma. He used the mixer to make lukewarm water, then used it to make some coffee. While waiting for the mixer, he killed Genda. Before that, he killed Kishimoto and placed the shogi board with three missing legs to confuse the order of the murders. He also set the AC temperature high, so that the body would be found with a high rectal temperature delaying the time of death.

motive.zhHans: 他还将空调温度调高，以便尸体被发现时直肠温度较高，从而推迟死亡时间推定。随后赤井鸣响汽车喇叭，让秀吉知道他和柯南是来救他的。当他把这件事告诉其他人时，其他人让他遵守沉默规则，即如果他们当中有人面临暴露的危险，他要保守团队的秘密并自杀以保护其他人。在得知还有另外两人参与这个作弊团伙后，他也决定将他们一并杀死，以为他最好的朋友Kinji报仇。
motive.en: He also set the AC temperature high, so that the body would be found with a high rectal temperature delaying the time of death. Akai then honks the car horn so that Shukichi knows that he and Conan are there to rescue him. When he told the others, they told him to follow the rule of silence, which means that if any of them were in danger of being exposed, he would keep the group's secret and kill himself to protect the others. After learning that two others were involved in this cheating circle, he decided to kill them as well in order to avenge his best friend Kinji.

method.zhHans: 他用搅拌机制作温水，然后用它冲了一些咖啡。秀吉通过盲棋向柯南和赤井说出他被绑架的房间。柯南用手机找到了秀吉的确切位置。在原版漫画中，Kishimoto的死因不明，而在第1035集的回忆片段中则显示他死于被刺。
method.en: He used the mixer to make lukewarm water, then used it to make some coffee. Using blind shogi, Shukichi tells Conan and Akai the room where he is abducted. Using his phone, Conan finds Shukichi’s exact location. In the original manga version, Kishimoto's cause of death is unknown, whereas it is shown that he died from being stabbed in a flashback from episode 1035.

evidence.zhHans: 他还将空调温度调高，以便尸体被发现时直肠温度较高，从而推迟死亡时间推定。Hishinuma认为自杀可疑，追踪到该团伙成员之一Nishikido，强迫他交代一切后将其杀死。
evidence.en: He also set the AC temperature high, so that the body would be found with a high rectal temperature delaying the time of death. Hishinuma, who found the suicide suspicious, tracked down one of the members of the group Nishikido and forced him to confess everything before killing him.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是Kosuke Hishinuma。他用搅拌机制作温水，然后用它冲了一些咖啡。在等待搅拌机的期间，他杀死了Genda。在此之前，他杀死了Kishimoto，并放置了缺了三条腿的将棋盘以扰乱杀人顺序。他还将空调温度调高，以便尸体被发现时直肠温度较高，从而推迟死亡时间推定。他们最终抵达了秀吉被绑架并带往的公寓。随后赤井鸣响汽车喇叭，让秀吉知道他和柯南是来救他的。秀吉通过盲棋向柯南和赤井说出他被绑架的房间。然而，为了做到这一点，秀吉不得不故意走出一步坏棋。Hishinuma察觉了这一点，随后发现了手机并将其砸碎。他威胁秀吉说会杀了他。
resolution.en: The culprit is Kosuke Hishinuma. He used the mixer to make lukewarm water, then used it to make some coffee. While waiting for the mixer, he killed Genda. Before that, he killed Kishimoto and placed the shogi board with three missing legs to confuse the order of the murders. He also set the AC temperature high, so that the body would be found with a high rectal temperature delaying the time of death. They finally arrived at the apartment where Shukichi was abducted and taken to. Akai then honks the car horn so that Shukichi knows that he and Conan are there to rescue him. Using blind shogi, Shukichi tells Conan and Akai the room where he is abducted. However, to do that, Shukichi had to intentionally make a bad move. Hishinuma realizes it, then discovers the phone and smashes it. He threatens Shukichi saying that he will kill him.
